1059.d: To complete your quest, you must talk to {npc,1222::Master Apro Simate}.

1052.d: Speak to {npc,1222::Master Apro Simate} to start a quest (NPC with a quest for you to carry out will have an exclamation mark above their heads).

1043.d: Left-click on {npc,1222::Master Apro Simate} and chose the "Speak" option to speak to him.

1046.d: Left-click on the {monster,2785::Incarnam Scarecrow} to start a fight.

1057.d: You should have followed Het Dawa's advice and taken care. Now it seems your life is on the line. Alas, life is not as simple as one would think.

1058.d: With your help, Het Dawa should be able to eradicate the illness that has affected the Pandawan beverage market, provided an antidote can be found.

1056.d: You've just arrived, and you've already been offered a way to make your life easier and without much effort, either. What more could you want?

1091.d: Abominable creatures have broken into Father Kwismas' workshop. You must recover the boxes of presents they have stolen, with or without their consent, and take them to Harry Kwismas.

996.d: Go to your class temple and fight the Dopple you find there.

884.d: Snori Nairb has promised to share his Kamas and his experience with you if you re-enlist in the Bontarian militia.

576.d: According to Elviana Tirips a medium would be able to help you locate the Spirit of Light. As the medium has disappeared, you must first find her.

577.d: You must find the Spirit of Light associated with the hammer and persuade her to follow you to Bonta.
577.n: Find and convince the Spirit of Light.

966.d: Apparently Ebru of El still needs your help with the Hammer of Light and its spirit.

567.d: You took part in the trial of Kit Dingaround and your opinion has played its part. You can now get back to work.

562.d: Satirev Onivin has broken his hammer and has asked you for a new one. As he is stubborn, he refuses to use anything other than a Scraping Hammer.

563.d: Danathor wishes to speak to you before the trial, it seems urgent.

561.d: Amayiro asked you to find the Sram who threatened Robin Gaywould. The only clue: he regularly goes into the sewer manhole located in the city's southeast corner.

962.d: You must find a Hypnomeow to use in the interrogation of Gnirreh before the trial starts.

566.d: Having investigated the case of Kit Dingaround's treason, you are asked to testify. Now it's up to you whose side you choose.

973.d: You must convince Greu Nouille to help you capture a flutterthought linked to Solar, to take to Danathor.

972.d: Meuh Sieurchance is suffering from amnesia. You must follow Shaman Surivitna's instructions if you hope to heal him.

971.d: You must get hold of a Lost Thought belonging to the late Protector, Solar. Alchemists may be able to help you.

64.d: Become the king of the world.

65.d: I want less XP and less Kamas.

766.d: You must go to the east part of the rampart and defeat Bontarians.

970.d: There's a Wyrmwell in one of Dardondakal's old lairs. The entrance to this lair is hidden in the Forest of Cania, and to find it, you'll need to possess the correct items.

969.d: You need to capture some dragon Memory Fragments for Danathor. You don't know where you could find them, but the art of divination should be able to help.

788.d: Terra Cogita has information on the location of Statuettes of Sumens. Elviana has instructed you to find them before the Brakmarians do.

546.d: Kit Dingaround is accused of treason but Amayiro believes he is innocent. He asks you to talk to Kit, who is currently in prison, and get his version of events, and to confirm what he tells you.

559.d: Amayiro has asked you to question the witness who has accused Kit Dingaround of treason until they reveal something interesting. You'll probably find them at Atyu Servis' Inn.

560.d: You must retrace Kit Dingaround's steps on the day of his arrest and interrogate the people you meet during your journey.

475.d: Xarthan is not home. Seize the opportunity to search his house. You'll need a competent handyman to come with you.

924.d: Xarthan is going to the Tower of Bonta to meet a Brakmarian after his meeting with some important people. You should hurry so as not to miss him.

802.d: Justfa Lafs needs magically altered seeds for breeding Piwis. Merlinmagus Ambrosius knows the recipe.
802.n: A Piwi in the hand is worth two in the bush.

801.d: Justfa Lafs fears that Brakmar has sent agents to steal the Statuette of Sumens that is being kept in the Tower of Bonta. He has asked you to protect it.

967.d: Danathor needs you. This story concerns a magical gift, or something like that.

968.d: You need to talk to the Rogues and bargain with them for a Fragment of Time that the Demons of the Hours stole.

557.d: In exchange for a delay to the investigation, Judge Satirev Onivin requires a barrel of Shambrosia to refresh the prisoners and an Astrubian woman to refresh his body.

551.d: Even though Judge Satirev Onivin dislikes lengthy trials, Amayiro has sent you to him to ask for more time. He spends most of his time in the Militia building.

554.d: You got an extension. Amayiro will be delighted to hear that.

534.d: You found the spy on time. But are you going to follow the orders, take the documents and leave him here?

144.d: The Xelors seem to be interested. According to Ant, they would like to put hands on their hourglass... well he's not really sure.

115.d: Qil Bil has been seen near the Sidimote plains.                 Qil Bil is wanted for pulling out human limbs.             Sentenced to imprisonment in Astrub.

883.d: Snori Nairb has promised to share his Kamas and his experience with you if you re-enlist in the Brakmarian militia.

32.d: To test his theory about the emergence of carnivorous flowers, Trapchet wants you to sow some dark rose seeds and harvest the plants.
32.n: He who sows the wynd shall reap the Whirlwynd

5.d: Three-Flower, a friend of Trapchet, lives in Amakna and knows the flora of the area thoroughly. Go ask him for some information about the aggressive flowers in this area.
5.n: The good the bad and the flora

3.d: Erty Trapchet would like to study some dandelion seeds to compare them with some Epyss...

2.d: Erty Trapchet forgot to look after his plants, you have to go to his place and water them.

4.d: For his research, Trapchet needs to study the geographical distribution of the flowers around Astrub.

143.d: Some dark creatures are ruining Ant Emicheun's business. The answer would be to get rid of them.... at least until he can understand what they are doing here...

141.d: No more disease in the sick Tofu feathers. On the other hand their eggs would probably be useful to the Eniripsa. Another few Kamas to be earned!

21.d: You suddenly feel the need to learn more about yourself and decide to go to a blood-drenched place.... The butcher's.

25.d: Your master heard that a worker at the mine was recently turned into a dark miner. He wants to know the whole story.

41.d: A group of Enutrofs have made a discovery... They'll need your help to find out more.

46.d: The flower won't do as it is, you must make tea with it!

47.d: You have to bring the tea to your guild master so that a staff can be made. If it's possible and if you have time, bring some tea to your florist as well, it will make them very happy.

44.d: You must find some Dizbi flowers if you want your class master to make a staff worthy of its name.

118.d: Allisteria's Gobballs are hungry. They need to be fed... all of them!

127.d: Save the good Stewed Black Gobball Pudding tradition.

132.d: The famous Fallanster asked you to train his daughter to be a fighter.

160.d: The water way consist in resisting by any means to any water absorption or submersion (partly or totally submerged), not drinking deliberately or washing yourself (except if extremely necessary). Find the master of the water way: he knows more than he seem to do.
160.n: It is forbidden to sell water to people under the age of...

159.d: A Pandawaiian soft drink saleswoman advises you to talk to Lenald the Wise. According to her, he is the only one to know the truth about Pandala and its mysteries.

157.d: Grandapan gladly accepted the Enutrofs' gift. As an ardent admirer of the Dofus hunters, he gives you a warm welcome.

156.d: The Enutrof having a cure by the Shaman advise you to visit Grandapan. He is really knowledgeable about the local folklore  and the Pandawaiians legends

158.d: Thanks to your help, the Shaman assistant can start the thank-you ritual to the Goddess. He will be ready right after you offer him a traditional padawaiian gift.

259.d: The King likes to ride, you must find him Dragoturkeys.
